join: Exact original cell_id and UTC year; all 997 original cells in each year 2013–2021.
cohort: Only saved eligibility=eligible rows enter observed/predicted comparisons. Exclude unknown labels and the frozen flagged zeros from both sides. Null predictions remain missing.
historical_rate: The original 2001–2021 historical panel retains its reviewed-label denominator, including flagged zeros. It is separate from the matched ML comparison.
expected_cells: Sum of saved probabilities: expected recorded-positive cells, not incident counts. No independence assumption is needed for the expectation; no confidence interval is inferred.
ranking: Raw percentile and top-decile membership are copied from the original annual three-county cohort. County filters do not rerank or recalculate the budget.
aggregation: County/year descriptive summaries of saved geographic fits. Pooled sums are not the equal-weight annual model-selection metrics.
limits: Development years informed model and calibration choices; not an independent final test.
Maps combine five geographic fits per year, not a newly fitted deployment model.
Reporting changes, unknown labels, unequal cell areas and retrospective climate availability remain unresolved.
